name: Historic Center / Plaza Mayor
tagline: The postcard heart of colonial Trinidad
description: The UNESCO-listed core around the Plaza Mayor is where Trinidad's pastel mansions, cobbled lanes, and grand church converge. You are steps from museums, music houses, and the best casas particulares, surrounded by the town's most photographed streetscapes and steady, gentle foot traffic day and night.
vibe: Historic, atmospheric, tourist-facing but genuinely beautiful
bestFor: First-time visitors who want to be in the middle of everything
pros: Walk to the Plaza Mayor, museums, and music venues
Highest concentration of quality casas particulares
cons: Cobbled streets are hard on luggage and ankles
Busiest and priciest part of town

name: Casa de la Musica / Calle Rosario
tagline: Where the music never really stops
description: Just off the Plaza Mayor, the streets around the Casa de la Musica steps and Calle Rosario form Trinidad's nightlife heart. Live son and salsa bands play most evenings on the famous open-air staircase, with bars, casas, and dancers spilling into the warm night air.
bestFor: Music and dance lovers who want nightlife on their doorstep
pros: Nightly live music at the Casa de la Musica steps
Central, walkable, and full of atmosphere
Easy to meet locals and travelers
cons: Evening music can be loud for light sleepers
Popular, so casas fill quickly in season

name: Road to Playa Ancon / La Boca
tagline: Sea breezes and the fishing-village pace
description: Southwest of town, the road toward Playa Ancon passes through La Boca, a rustic fishing village on the coast. It trades colonial grandeur for sea views, simple casas, and easy access to Trinidad's best beaches, with a slower, saltier rhythm just a short ride from the center.
bestFor: Beach lovers who prize sea access over old-town buzz
pros: Close to Playa Ancon and La Boca swim spots
Cooler sea breezes and open water views
Quieter and more relaxed than the center
cons: Away from the historic core and nightlife
Fewer services; you rely on transport into town

name: Residential Trinidad (outside the historic core)
tagline: Everyday local life beyond the cobbles
description: Beyond the UNESCO center, Trinidad's residential neighborhoods spread out with ordinary streets, local shops, and family homes. Quieter and more affordable, these areas give a truer sense of daily Cuban life, with fewer tourists, more space, and a short walk or ride into the colonial heart.
bestFor: Longer-stay travelers wanting local life and lower prices
pros: More affordable casas and everyday prices
Quieter nights away from the music crowds
cons: A walk or ride from the main sights and venues
Fewer tourist services and paladares nearby
